name: Fairness: Section 1557 decision support tools and subgroup performance
description: Fairness: Section 1557 decision support tools and subgroup performance. From the Shio policy pack specification; draft, not reviewed.
limits: Draft and unreviewed. Planned controls are listed for coverage and not enforced.

controls.title: An inventory of decision support uses of race
controls.requirement: An inventory of decision support uses of race, colour, national origin, sex, age or disability, from the agent card.

controls.title: Reasonable efforts to mitigate discrimination risk are recorded
controls.requirement: Reasonable efforts to mitigate discrimination risk are recorded.

controls.title: Protected-attribute inputs are declared per agent
controls.requirement: Protected-attribute inputs are declared per agent; undeclared use fails compile.

controls.title: Subgroup sensitivity
controls.requirement: Subgroup sensitivity, specificity and error rate meet the stated tolerance before deployment.

controls.title: Patient-facing output is tested in the languages and formats served
controls.requirement: Patient-facing output is tested in the languages and formats served.

controls.title: Proxy variables standing in for a protected class are flagged
controls.requirement: Proxy variables standing in for a protected class are flagged.

controls.title: Fairness results are re-run after each change
controls.requirement: Fairness results are re-run after each change.
